description:
Permanently delete an order from StarShipIt. This action is irreversible — the order will be removed from the system entirely.

**When to use:** Only use on unshipped orders that were created in error and must be removed. For orders you want to retain but hide from the queue, use `starshipit_archive_order` instead.

**Parameters:**
- `order_id` (required) — StarShipIt internal order ID to permanently delete

**Returns:** Confirmation message on success.

**Warning:** This is a destructive, permanent action. The order cannot be recovered after deletion.

**Errors:** 404 if order not found; 409 if the order has already been shipped (cannot delete shipped orders — use archive instead); 401 if API keys invalid.

order_id.description: StarShipIt internal order ID to permanently delete

name: starshipit_delete_order

outputSchema.description: Raw StarShipIt API response; not truncated

errors.description: Validation or processing errors returned by StarShipIt

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: Delete Order
